institute.name: Helix Anthropis Institute
institute.tagline: Working together towards the advancement of humanity and the common good.

mission: To promote and facilitate initiatives that contribute to the advancement of humanity and the common good, without discrimination, through cooperation, knowledge and innovation.
vision: A world in which people and institutions work together across borders and disciplines, so that every person can live, learn and flourish within the limits of a shared planet.
story: A few friends came together with a dream and want to make it a reality.

member.label: Member
member.note: A seat and a vote at every assembly. Access to the Discord, the members' newsletter and project teams.

eco.label: Eco Champion
eco.note: Everything in Member, plus 10% off store products and your name in the annual report.

visionary.label: Visionary
visionary.note: Everything in Eco Champion, plus 20% off store products and an invitation to the yearly Visionaries' dinner with the board.
